CdsFileShareLinkModel.description_en: The data entity of the file sharing link
CdsFileShareLinkModel.description_zh: 文件分享链接数据实体

AccessCount.description_en: The number of times to access the shared file
AccessCount.title: 访问次数

Creator.description_en: The user that creates the file sharing task
Creator.title: 创建者

DisableDownload.description_en: The shared file is forbidden from being downloaded
DisableDownload.description_zh: 禁止下载正在分享的文件
DisableDownload.title: 禁止下载分享中的文件

DisablePreview.description_en: The shared file is forbidden from being previewed
DisablePreview.description_zh: 禁止预览正在分享的文件
DisablePreview.title: 禁止预览分享中的文件

DisableSave.description_en: The shared file is forbidden from being dumped
DisableSave.description_zh: 禁止转存分享中的文件
DisableSave.title: 禁止转存分享中的文件

DownloadCount.description_en: The number of times that the shared file can be downloaded
DownloadCount.title: 下载次数

DownloadLimit.description_en: The maximum number of times that the shared file can be downloaded
DownloadLimit.title: 分享下载次数限制

Expiration.description_en:
The time when the file sharing link expires.

The value must be in the FC3339 format. Example: 2020-06-28T11:33:00.000+08:00. If the parameter is left empty, the file sharing link is permanently valid
Expiration.title: 失效时间点。 RFC3339格式，比如："2020-06-28T11:33:00.000+08:00"。 永久有效：""

Expired.description_en: Specifies whether the file sharing link expires
Expired.title: 是否过期

PreviewCount.description_en: The number of times that the shared file is previewed
PreviewCount.title: 预览次数

PreviewLimit.description_en: The maximum number of times that the shared file can be previewed
PreviewLimit.title: 分享预览次数限制

ReportCount.description_en: The number of times that the shared file is reported due to content violation
ReportCount.title: 被举报次数

SaveCount.description_en: The number of times that the shared files can be dumped
SaveCount.title: 转存次数

SaveLimit.description_en: The maximum number of times that the shared file can be saved
SaveLimit.title: 分享转存次数限制

ShareName.description_en: The shared file name. By default, the name of the first shared file is used
ShareName.description_zh: 分享名，默认使用第一个文件名
ShareName.title: 分享名，默认使用第一个文件名

SharePwd.description_en: The access code. It must contain up to 64 characters in length. 0 characters indicates that there is no access code
SharePwd.description_zh: 提取码，0-64个字符。长度0表示没有提取码
SharePwd.title: 提取码，0-64个字符。长度0表示没有提取码。

VideoPreviewCount.description_en: The number of times that the audio and video file is played
VideoPreviewCount.title: 音视频播放次数

CdsFileShareLinkModel.title: 文件分享链接数据实体

parameters.help_en: The extraction code. Length range: 0 to 64 bytes. If this parameter is not set or is set to empty, no extraction code is required, and you do not need to specify the extraction code parameter when obtaining the share token. Only printable ASCII characters are allowed
parameters.help_zh: 提取码长度范围：0\~64字节。不设置或者设置为空，表示无提取码，在获取分享令牌的时候也不用设置提取码参数。 要求使用ASCII可见字符
parameters.name: share_pwd

parameters.help_en: The expiration time in RFC 3339 format. If this parameter is left empty, the share is permanently valid
parameters.help_zh: 失效时间点。 RFC3339格式。 当取值为空时，表示永久有效
parameters.name: expiration

parameters.help_en: The share description. Length range: 0 to 1024 characters
parameters.help_zh: 分享描述。 长度范围为0\~1024个字符
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The share name. If this parameter is not set, the file name corresponding to the first ID in `file_id_list` is used by default. Length range: 0 to 128 characters
parameters.help_zh: 分享名。 如果未设置，默认使用`file_id_list`中的第一个ID对应的文件名。 长度范围为0\~128个字符
parameters.name: share_name

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to disable previewing of files in the share. Valid values:

true: Preview is disabled.
false: Preview is enabled
parameters.help_zh: 是否禁止预览分享中的文件
parameters.name: disable_preview

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to disable saving of files in the share. Valid values:

true: Saving is disabled.
false: Saving is enabled
parameters.help_zh: 是否禁止转存分享中的文件
parameters.name: disable_save

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to disable downloading of files in the share. Valid values:

true: Downloading is disabled.
false: Downloading is enabled
parameters.help_zh: 是否禁止下载分享中的文件
parameters.name: disable_download

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of times the shared files can be previewed. The value is an integer. A value of 0 indicates no limit
parameters.help_zh: 分享预览次数限制。取值范围为整数，取值为0时表示不限制
parameters.name: preview_limit

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of times the shared files can be saved. The value is an integer. A value of 0 indicates no limit
parameters.help_zh: 分享转存次数限制。取值范围为整数，取值为0时表示不限制
parameters.name: save_limit

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of times the shared files can be downloaded. The value is an integer. A value of 0 indicates no limit
parameters.help_zh: 分享下载次数限制。取值范围为整数，取值为0时表示不限制
parameters.name: download_limit

parameters.help_en: The ID of the user who uses the cloud disk
parameters.name: end_user_id

Code.description_en: The execution result. A value of `success` indicates success. Otherwise, an error message is returned
Code.description_zh: 执行结果。返回`success`表示成功，否则将返回错误信息

Message.description_en: The error message. This parameter is not returned when Code is `success`
Message.description_zh: 错误信息。当Code为`success`时，不返回该参数

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the operation is successful. Valid values:

true: The operation is successful.
false: The operation failed
